about: The introitus of the formulary “First Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: He will call on Me, and I will answer him; I will rescue him and glorify him; I will fill him with length of days. He who dwells in the help of the Most High will abide in the protection of the God of heaven. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. He will call on Me, and I will answer him; I will rescue him and glorify him; I will fill him with length of days.
